column1: # MSVCR110 math, rand and qsort results: function, argument bits (one or two doubles), result bits;
# rand: seed, then the first 12 values; qsort: count, key range, seed, then the ids in sorted order
# of (key, id) pairs sorted by key alone (keys from xorshift32, state seed*0x9e3779b9|1, key = state % range).
# Generated by calling the game's own msvcr110.dll (32-bit) from a small i686 program on Windows
# (x87 control word 0x027f, as on the game thread).
